whys.why: Why does src/legacy.ts still hold an any cast and a for loop?
whys.because: It predates the disciplines and has not been edited since they were adopted.

whys.why: Why has src/legacy.ts not been edited since the disciplines were adopted?
whys.because: No change has needed it: its two helpers are called only by the yearly stock report.

whys.why: Why are its helpers called only by the yearly stock report?
whys.because: The stock report was the first feature built, and newer features were written against the typed parser instead.

whys.why: Why were newer features written against the typed parser instead?
whys.because: The typed parser arrived with the disciplines' adoption, and paying down old callers was queued, not done in the same change.

whys.why: Why was paying down the old callers queued instead of done in the adoption change?
whys.because: The adoption's owner chose to carve out existing debt and pay it on touch, so adoption could land in one review.

whyChain.rootCause: The team decided at adoption to carve out existing debt and pay it when the file is next touched.
